name: Yoga Movement Academy

brand_voice.summary: Aspirational, supportive and grounded. Yoga Movement Academy runs YMTT (Yoga Movement Teacher Training). Copy speaks to dedicated students whose practice has started to feel like something they want to share, and reassures them they do not need to have it all figured out.
signature_phrases: Your voice belongs in the room
You don't need to have it all figured out
Future yoga teachers, this one's for you
rules: Write the programme as YMTT (Yoga Movement Teacher Training) and the brand as Yoga Movement Academy.
Focus on skills and growth: cueing, supporting, holding space, leading with confidence.
Tuition support should be described as "up to 50%" unless the brief confirms a flat 50%.
Position teaching as a natural next step for people who keep showing up to practise.
avoid: Implying applicants must already be advanced or "perfect" practitioners

products.name: YMTT
products.description: Yoga Movement Teacher Training. Builds skills in movement, cueing, supporting students and holding space, with practice, feedback and community.
